answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop sybil floods. Each hour a beacon picks random agents, and each must echo back a cipher-signed proof of live work within 60 seconds, proving real compute. A gale of fake accounts cannot keep up: forging 100 identities costs 100 machine-seconds per check, about $2 of rented compute, for one reward worth $0.50. Honest agents pay only one heartbeat and keep their full share, undiluted by fakes.
